name: ShopToAds
tagline: Turn product photos and public store links into static image ads.

pricing.notes: Basic includes 250 monthly credits. Annual Basic is $478 billed yearly.
pricing.freeTier: Eligible new users receive 30 one-time starter credits that expire after 30 days; there is no recurring free generation allowance.

verdictSummary: A small local app can turn an uploaded product photo and a brief into several static layouts using an image API and a fixed template. Handling public product links safely, keeping packaging details recognizable across variations, and making retries predictable take more work. A prototype also depends on paid image inference.
coreLoopDIY: Upload a product photo, generate background variants, compose static ad layouts with your own headline and CTA, and export PNGs.
whatYouLose: Product information extraction from public store links
Refinement and consistent product appearance across image variants
Ready-to-use layouts across multiple ad placements
moatNotes: The practical work is reliable URL ingestion, image consistency, and predictable retries and exports.
whyPeopleStillPay: Teams can work from existing product photos or public product pages, compare several creative directions, and revise or download the results without maintaining image generation, layout, or job infrastructure.
notes: Exports flattened static PNG artwork. It does not generate video or publish campaigns.
prompt:
Build a local product photo to static ad prototype in an empty folder.
Use Node.js 22, Express, multer, sharp, and a plain HTML and JavaScript UI.
Run on localhost only. Do not add accounts, storage services, telemetry, or billing.
Accept one PNG, JPEG, or WebP photo, at most 4 MB.
Validate MIME type and decode the image before making any provider request.
Ask for a creative brief, a headline, and a CTA. Treat this copy as plain text.
Offer square and portrait layouts, with a batch size from one to three.
Use the OpenAI Node SDK image editing API with OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL from server environment variables.
Request background concepts from the brief. Keep the uploaded photo as a separate layer so the product itself does not change.
Composite the original photo and user-entered copy with sharp, then export PNGs.
Reserve safe margins, wrap text, and enforce minimum contrast for readable output.
Show all variants with individual download buttons and actionable error messages.
Add a mock generation mode that produces local solid-color backgrounds without an API key.
Keep uploads in memory and discard them after the response. Never log photos or API keys.
Leave URL import, project history, image refinement, and ad publishing out of scope.
Provide an npm start command, environment variable examples, and steps to try mock mode.
